name: pibox
description: pi-coding-agent running in a container — interactive shell, one-shot exec, an HTTP REST API, an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint, an MCP server, a Telegram bot, and a cron scheduler, all on one image.

pibox_url.title: pibox URL
pibox_url.description: Base URL of your running pibox server, e.g. http://localhost:8080

api_token.title: pibox API token
api_token.description: Bearer token for the REST / OpenAI-compatible API surface (PIBOX_API_MODE_TOKEN). Leave empty if the server was started without auth.

mcp_token.title: pibox MCP token
mcp_token.description: Bearer token for the MCP surface (PIBOX_MCP_MODE_TOKEN) — separate from the API token, no fallback between the two.
